title: Don't panic. Just pray.
note: 9 slides; slide 7 redrawn once for a stray quote mark and doodle
audio: Peace Be Still by Hope Darst
caption:
Which slide are you keeping? Comment its number.

For the heart that has been restless lately, here is a little peace to carry through today. You are held, even when it does not feel that way.

Philippians 4:6, Exodus 14:14, Isaiah 26:3, John 16:33, Matthew 6:34, Psalm 94:19, Philippians 4:7, John 14:27 (BSB)

slides.text: Be still. He is already working.
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!
Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself.
When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.
The peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts
Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you.
